Inspect regional taper and volume conventions

Source: R/stem-smalltapers.R
regional_small_tapers.Rd

Regional families retain the source National Volume Estimator Library profile paths. get_taper_model() returns each identifier's input requirements.

Details

r1_taper uses the Byrne lodgepole diameter profile and species-specific total volumes. r2_taper includes Max-Burkhart profiles with Czaplewski correction and conditioned profiles requiring an upper-stem measurement pair.

r5_taper uses the Wensel and Krumland profile. r12_taper retains Sharpneck total volume with supplied form_class. Its public diameter calculation uses the source Raile stump fallback.

blm_taper selects Bureau of Land Management profile groups and source form-class defaults. behre_taper uses the source Behre hyperbola. Their total-volume calculations require form_class even where diameter calculations can obtain a default.

These families require bark_ratio for outside-bark calculations. Default inverse calculations retain the highest crossing of the public profile. Source compatibility reproduces the source's rounded search and unavailable branches.

Unavailable species total

100JB2W019 returns a zero ground-to-tip total because the source leaves its species index unassigned. The calculation does not diagnose this unavailable species total.

See also

get_taper_model(), dob(), height_at_dib(), stem_volume().

Examples

## Inspect an equation with an unavailable species total
get_taper_model(id = '100JB2W019')
#> <taper_model 100JB2W019>
#>   family: r1_taper
#>   kernel: compiled
#>   units: imperial
#>   oracle verified: yes
#>   capabilities: inverse, integral

## Check its ground-to-tip volume behavior
stem_volume(dbh = 20,
            ht = 100,
            model = '100JB2W019',
            lower = 0,
            lower_type = 'height',
            status = TRUE)
#>   value status
#> 1     0      0
